members.mistake: accept when p > q: the plate is kept exactly when p is bigger than q at its dish, with no coin, so a plate whose q is at least its p is always sent back
accept with p/q but resample from p: a plate that is sent back is replaced by a dish picked from p itself and not from the residual (p - q)+
resample from q: a plate that is sent back is replaced by a dish picked from the commis's own q and not from the residual (p - q)+
an off-by-one in the residual: the excess of each dish is written one place along, wrapping at the end of the vocabulary, so the dish that replaces a plate is the one after the right one

the boundary-inclusive comparison of SGLang PR #35798: <= where < is right, in the accept step and in the walk over the weights, so one coin too many is kept and a draw that lands on a boundary goes to the dish before it
a FLy-style lossy rule: a plate that is sent back at a flat target is kept anyway when the next plate would be kept, so the output drifts from p toward q
